notes: PARTIAL approved runtime rule pack: only the Honeywell MVP Batch 1 configuration-expansion decisions are active. The full 53-child-line Honeywell candidate pack is NOT approved. Batch 2 (term-coupled support/licensing), Batch 3 (replacement candidates), and Batch 4 (broader Cisco generalization) remain deferred. No pricing authority is encoded here; what to add/default/offer is configuration authority, while pricing is resolved separately from the catalog/price source at runtime, so the two stay strictly separate. The source candidate packs (data/config-expansion/honeywell-candidate-rules.json, data/config-expansion/honeywell-candidate-rules-v2.json) and the review packets remain unchanged and candidate/pending; this approved pack is a new, separate artifact.
